verdict.rationale: Fedora documents up-to-date packages, tools and runtimes installable with a single command, plus container tooling and developer guides. Community users confirm it ships the newest software and quickly became a working Python development workstation. AI/ML is undocumented, though: one user cites missing CUDA support and another cites Nvidia driver trouble, which weakens the AI/ML part of the story. Missing for 10: any first-party evidence of AI/ML stacks (CUDA/GPU compute), evidence that IDE and toolchain vendors treat Fedora as a primary supported platform, and named IDE availability.
